answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust defense against Sybil attacks in agent economies. By requiring agents to lock collateral, the system forces a capital-intensive voyage for any attacker seeking to manufacture identity reefs. Each node must whisper its cryptographic commitment to the ledger; an adversary attempting to spawn multiple identities faces the immense cost of dividing their stake, thereby diluting their influence and ensuring the network remains resilient against disproportionate synthetic control.
